posts.author: Sternenprinzessin
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
I’ve been making games for a while now and have already finished a (somewhat mediocre) game. Currently, I’m working on creating a new demo for another project.
I really enjoy story-driven games and parallax mapping, which I’d say I’m quite good at. But I also want to try out other things, like minigames.
I like RPG Maker games and enjoy testing new ones. I’m into all genres, but about 70% of the time I end up playing horror games. Maybe RPG Maker and horror just go really well together ^^
My current game is
no
not really horror, it’s more of an adventure game.
It’s currently in German (though if anyone can recommend a good translation plugin, I consider making an English version too). Since English is my third language, I’m still a bit clumsy with it.
I found this forum through various resources and thought it might be a good time to properly introduce myself ^^
If anyone has questions about how to create dynamic lighting and shadows using the Galv Layer plugin for MV, I’d be happy to help
(I love this plugin, even if it’s not very user-friendly and I would like to share what I learned)
Nice to meet you all,
Sternenprinzessin

posts.author: MiguelRPG
posts.body:
@Sternenprinzessin
Welcome!
I also enjoy RPG Maker games, especially horror games.
When my project was in MV, the best translation plugin I found was SRD Translation Engine:
https://someran.dev/rpgmaker/plugins/mv/SRD_TranslationEngine.js/
They even made a tool to help with the plugin:
RPG Maker MV Translation Helper by CodeKnack
A helper tool to make it easier to translate RPG Maker MV projects.
codeknack.itch.io
It's a shame it's not available for MZ.
